jobs.text: The Mymensingh Gitika ballads were collected from village singers in the early twentieth century by Chandra Kumar Dey and edited by Dinesh Chandra Sen. They tell of love, courage and loss, in stories such as Mahua and Dewana Madina, and they are among the earliest written records of the folk poetry of this region.
